verdict.rationale: Baseten's API paths show a v1 prefix (e.g. GET /v1/model_apis/{model_api_name}) and there is a dedicated deprecation.md page instructing users to migrate to a dedicated deployment when a model API is deprecated, so both versioning and a deprecation policy exist in some form. However, the deprecation guidance is a single thin line ('Contact us for assistance') with no documented timelines, notice periods, or version-lifecycle policy, and no OpenAPI/versioning spec was found (openapi probe 404s). Missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme/changelog, detailed deprecation timelines/notice periods, and independent confirmation of how deprecations are communicated in practice.
